subject: Prompt regression warroom & compact acceptance playbook
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Anna Lowe <anna@clearco.com>
Date: 2026-09-12 09:12 PDT
Subject: Re: unusual drop in quality from promptset-v3 (AB) — proposed warroom

Heads up — ClearCo has flagged a material drop in accuracy for our promptset-v3 on their AB test (variant B). They see a ~12% decrease on the regression metric (intent precision) starting 2026-09-10.

I looked at the quick diffs and it looks like the model variant we rolled for lower cost quantization is returning truncated, more generic completions for a specific class of finance questions. This is impacting their core flows.

Proposed immediate steps:
- Stand up a 30m warroom today to align owners (SRE, Eval, Product).
- Pin ClearCo traffic to promptset-v2 fallback while we triage.
- Share a compact acceptance checklist for a quick re-qualification of v3.

Can you both join a sync at 10:30? Anna — can you confirm if ClearCo is comfortable with a short traffic pin (10–30 minutes) while we run tests?

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Product Ops, Redwood Inference

Attachment: promptset_v3-summary.csv (3kb) — summary of failing examples
From: Anna Lowe <anna@clearco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-12 09:27 PDT
Subject: Re: unusual drop in quality from promptset-v3 (AB) — proposed warroom

Thanks Marissa — yes, we can do a short pin to v2 for now. We prefer an explicit rollback window and a signal gate before unpinning.

We have capture logs and sample user prompts attached on our side; I uploaded a sanitized batch to the link in your drive folder.

—Anna
Director, Product @ ClearCo
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Anna Lowe <anna@clearco.com>
Date: 2026-09-12 10:34 PDT
Subject: Re: unusual drop in quality from promptset-v3 (AB) — proposed warroom

Joining. Quick notes ahead of the call:
- I'll prepare an A/B traffic-split snapshot and cold-start K/V cache heatmap to check if the degradation correlates with cache eviction.
- If this is quantization-related, we should be able to reproduce locally with the v3 quant profile and the failing prompt samples.
- Suggested warroom roles doc attached (warroom-roles.md).

On the pin: agree with Marissa — do a 20m pin then run three acceptance checks (intent precision, hallucination rate, and end-to-end sample pass). If any fail, keep v2 and start hotfix timeline.

Karthik
Lead, Model Serving
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lowe <anna@clearco.com>
Date: 2026-09-12 14:03 PDT
Subject: Re: unusual drop in quality from promptset-v3 (AB) — proposed warroom

Thanks all for the quick turnaround on the warroom. Notes from today's sync and decisions:

- Immediate: Pin ClearCo traffic to promptset-v2 at 14:00 PDT. Karthik to run local repros on failing sample set and share a short repro log.
- Acceptance compact checklist (for quick requalification of v3):
  1) Intent precision >= 95% on the sampled set (minute-scale metric).
  2) Hallucination rate <= baseline + 1.5% relative.
  3) End-to-end QA pass on 50 random production samples from ClearCo.
- Owners: Marissa (primary customer comms), Karthik (triage + repro), Rishi (rollback orchestration + rollout gating).
- Escalation: If repro shows quantization regression, we target a 48h hotfix cycle; otherwise, we treat as promptset phrasing sensitivity and schedule a prompt engineering pass in the next sprint.

Action items assigned:
- Karthik: upload ab-traffic-split-logs.txt and repro notes to the drive by EOD.
- Rishi: prepare the rollback runbook and confirm DB of pinned routes (complete by 15:30).
- Marissa: send ClearCo the compact acceptance checklist and expected timelines.

I'll ping legal/enterprise if we need any SLA credit approvals after we finish the triage.

Sofia
Head of Eval Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Anna Lowe <anna@clearco.com>
Date: 2026-09-13 11:05 PDT
Subject: Re: Pinning update + rollback runbook

Pinned at 14:00 yesterday; we kept the pin for 25 minutes while Karthik ran repros. Observations:
- Karthik's replicant reproduced the generic completions on ~82% of the failing sample set when using the v3 quant profile.
- No obvious cache correlation found in the initial heatmap.
- Attached: ab-traffic-split-logs.txt and a short rollout-trace excerpt.

Given repro, my recommendation is:
1) Keep ClearCo on promptset-v2 while we push v3-quant-fix branch to staging.
2) Immediate hotfix timeline: 48h as discussed.
3) For the acceptance gate on re-release, add a short smoke test against a small class of finance prompts to catch this class earlier.

I started the rollback runbook and put the safe unpin checklist under the shared drive link. Will loop in SRE if we need a fast rollback to other customers.

Rishi
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Anna Lowe <anna@clearco.com>
Date: 2026-09-14 16:18 PDT
Subject: Re: Warroom closeout & next steps

Closeout update:
- Karthik uploaded the quant-fix branch PR and unit repro logs at 09:40. The PR includes a tighter decoding constraint for the affected finance prompt family.
- Rishi validated the rollback runbook; safe unpin checklist added.
- I shared the compact acceptance checklist with Anna; ClearCo agreed to a constrained unpin window and we scheduled a joint smoke run tomorrow morning.

Next steps / owners:
- Karthik: finish integration tests and request staging rollout (target: 2026-09-15 08:00 PDT).
- Rishi: prepare a monitoring dashboard with the three acceptance signals and toast alert thresholds.
- Sofia: escalate to legal/finance only if we surface customer-impact billing exceptions.

Thanks for the quick cross-functional response — keeping this thread for the handoff into the hotfix sprint.

Marissa
Sr. Product Ops, Redwood Inference
